# What if AI lived on your PC and not in a tab?

What is Stuard

Stuard is the AI workspace for your PC. Create tools, agents, and workflows that share one context and one unified memory. Stop spending $20 a month on 10+ AI tabs.

You became the bridge between your AI tools.

One memory. Every model. Your machine.

05 / The deep end

## Then there's the work that takes all afternoon.

A question gets you an answer. A real job needs a hundred sources, your own files, and something that keeps working after you look away.

### Deep research that ends in a file. Not a tab.

Ask for the landscape, the literature, the competitor teardown. It reads for twenty minutes and hands you a cited report, saved to your disk. Then it drafts the email about it, because it is the same assistant.

research run · 62 sources · 1 report.md

### It searches the whole web. And your disk.

Every question fans out across multiple search indexes at once, merged and deduped, then split between sub-researchers reading different threads in parallel. The tool in your browser tab has never seen the folder where you keep your own numbers. This one cites both.

2 search indexes · 4 sub-researchers · deduped by url

### A project you enter. Not a chat you re-explain.

Drop in the files, the links, the half-finished drafts. Every chat inside already knows what you decided last week and which version won. Come back in a month and it is all still there, waiting to tell you where you left off.

sources · timeline · memory · tasks

### It works on your machine. With your logins.

An agent in a rented cloud VM starts every job as a stranger: no files, no accounts, nothing but a browser and a guess. Stuard already has your apps open and your folders indexed. Close the lid and it hands the long jobs to the cloud, then keeps going.

local first · cloud only when you ask

08 / Private by architecture

## Your files never leave your PC.

Chat, files and screen stay on your machine. Nothing syncs unless you ask it to.

Connected accounts are touched only when you ask, under Google's Limited Use policy.

Every file edit and action is checkpointed. Revert any change, and permissions stay manual until you hand over full access.

Disconnect anything, anytime. We never train on your data, and never sell it.
